title: Write 6 · 认 识 哪 生 医 院 午 习 答 用 多 两 等 吗 天
focus: 认 识 哪 生 医 院 午 习 答 用 多 两 等 吗 天
body:
Repeating parts: 讠 speech (认, 识), 口 (哪, 吗, 识's 只), ⺮ bamboo (答, 等), 阝 (院, 哪's 那), 夕 (多).

## Rules that matter here
- **Three-sided boxes 匚**: 医 = top line, inside, then the left-and-bottom fold LAST.
- **Middle vertical last** when it splits the inside: 用.
- 午 vs 牛, 天 vs 夫: just one stroke differs.

cards.Notes: 讠 speech (2) + 人 person (2, phonetic rén) = 4 strokes. Left before right. Lookalike: 队 (阝 + 人).
讠 speech (2) + 只 (5: 口 + 八) = 7 strokes. Left before right. Also 知识 zhīshi.
口 mouth (3) + 那 that (6, phonetic) = 9 strokes. The 口 turns 'that' into 'which?'. Lookalike: 那 without 口.
5 strokes: ノ, 一, 一, the vertical, then the long bottom 一 last. A sprout coming out of the ground.
匚 box + 矢 arrow (5) = 7 strokes. Trap: top 一, then 矢 inside, then the 𠃋 (竖折) closing the left and bottom LAST.
阝 mound (2) + 完 (7: 宀 + 元, phonetic wán) = 9 strokes. 阝 on the left is written first.
4 strokes: ノ, 一, 一, vertical. Lookalike: 牛 niú (vertical pokes through the top).
3 strokes: 横折钩, the dot, then the rising stroke. Lookalike: 刁.
⺮ bamboo (6) + 合 join (6, phonetic-ish) = 12 strokes. Top before bottom; ⺮ is two small ノ一丶 sets.
5 strokes: ノ, 横折钩, 一, 一, then the middle vertical LAST. Lookalike: 甩, 月.
Two 夕 evening (3 + 3) = 6 strokes. Top 夕 first, then the bottom one, shifted right.

cards.Prompt: ＿个人 · liǎng ge rén · two people
cards.Notes: 7 strokes: 一, 丨, 横折钩, then two ノ丶 pairs (left pair first). Lookalike: 网 (with 㐅 inside).

cards.Prompt: ＿一下 · děng yíxià · wait a moment
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo (6) + 寺 temple (6, phonetic-ish) = 12 strokes. Top before bottom. Lookalike: 待 (彳 + 寺).
口 mouth (3) + 马 horse (3, phonetic mǎ) = 6 strokes. Left before right. Lookalikes: 妈 (女), 码 (石).
二 + 人 = 4 strokes: short top 一, longer 一, ノ, ㇏. Lookalike: 夫 (ノ pokes above the top line).
